name: resource-broker

plugins.name: resource-broker
plugins.description: Japanese-language tool. A bulletin board that keeps concurrent Claude Code sessions on one machine from fighting over finite resources: declare before you use, stay visible to everyone else. It never blocks a command, never inspects a resource, and never interprets a declaration. ／ 同じマシンで動く複数の Claude Code セッションが有限資源を取り合わないための掲示板。 The CLI output, hook notices and design docs are in Japanese; hooks can be silenced with RESOURCE_BROKER_DISABLE.

description: resource-broker 単体のマーケットプレイス。同じマシンで動く複数の Claude Code セッションが有限資源を取り合わないための掲示板を配る。
